request.spec:
A hold now has a from-date (default the sheet's today) and an optional to-date, and a person may
have several holds over time. Only a person's OPEN claims dated within a hold are left out of the
live totals; their other open claims count, and a claim bound by a statement stays in the totals
whatever its date. Show hold yes/no as whether the person has any hold. Holding writes
PERSON_HELD name=<name> from=<date>; releasing is no longer a separate action (a hold ends on
its to-date).

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A hold now has a from-date (default the sheet's today) and an optional to-date, and a person may
have several holds over time. Only a person's OPEN claims dated within a hold are left out of the
live totals; their other open claims count, and a claim bound by a statement stays in the totals
whatever its date. Show hold yes/no as whether the person has any hold. Holding writes
PERSON_HELD name=<name> from=<date>; releasing is no longer a separate action (a hold ends on

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A person can now have several holds, each with its own dates, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**How it works now**
- **A hold** has a from-date (blank means the sheet's today) and an optional to-date; with no to-date it never ends. A hold ending before it starts is refused and shows `person-error`.
- **What it leaves out:** only open claims (OPEN or PENDING) dated within a hold are dropped from the live totals. That covers the person's claimed and due totals, the overdue figures, the sheet totals, period totals and statements.
- **What still counts:** a claim bound by a statement counts whatever its date, and settled claims always count.
- **"On hold"** shows yes if the person has any hold at all.
- **Audit:** holding writes `PERSON_HELD … name=<name> from=<date>`, followed by the usual ROLLUP/TOTALS lines when the figures change. The release action and `PERSON_RELEASED` are gone.

**What changed**
- **Stored data:** migration `V31__person_hold_interval.sql` adds a `person_hold` table and drops the old `held` column. Anyone already on hold gets a hold from the start of time with no end, so their totals don't change.
- **Server:** a new `PersonHold` entity. `Person.counts(claim)` now checks the claim's date and whether it is bound. The hold endpoint takes `{from, to}`, and the person data the API returns now includes the list of holds.
- **Screen:** each person row has from/to date fields, a Hold button (`person-hold-toggle`) and one `person-hold-line` per hold. The front end's totals use the same rule as the server.

**Decisions to check**
- **Bound claims:** a PENDING claim isn't treated as bound by its statement while it is pending. So a PENDING claim dated within a hold is left out even if a statement covered it.
- **Not built:** `e2e/support/ui.ts` also has helpers for bulk hold and holding a single claim. No test uses them and the app didn't have them before, so I didn't add them.
